messages:
Alyssa (CSM): Quick follow-up from today's LuminaCare health check. We saw a repeat 503 spike during their nightly ingest (11:38–11:45 UTC). Opening this thread to capture owners and action items.
Ibrahim (Support Eng): saw the same. Error-rate for that window ~0.9%, p95 latency jumped from 220ms -> 640ms. Logs show model-serving returning 503 on forward requests, likely when KV cache grows.
Sam (SRE): ok — any correlating infra alerts? CPU/GPU saturation?
observability-bot: ALERT summary for lumina-ingest-prod: 11:36–11:46 UTC — 503s x 124, error_rate 0.92%, p95 latency 640ms, avg tokens/request +270. Link: https://obs.example/alerts/AB123
Ibrahim (Support Eng): no GPU OOMs reported, memory footprint on pods crept up; pod restarts = 2 in that window. Pattern: long sequences from batch client causing KV cache thrash + GC spikes.
Nora (LuminaCare): we re-ran the job with 2s backoff and it completed but retries spiked cost. This is worrying ahead of renewal next quarter — any ETA on a fix?
Kelsey (Onboarding): we can share a short-runbook for bursty batch ingestion to avoid triggering the path. Could also gate the job on a smaller chunking policy. Happy to draft.
Sam (SRE): immediate mitigations I can push today: 1) increase max replicas for model pool from 6 -> 10 for lumina-prod config, 2) enable fallback to smaller model variant when queue depth > X, 3) tweak request_timeout to fail-fast and reduce retries. Will run canary then roll.
Ibrahim (Support Eng): technical note — we should also enable prefix KV caching for their most common prompts; that will reduce cache growth. Need to coordinate with runtime team to flip the toggle.
Alyssa (CSM): action items: (A) Sam to raise and roll replica/config change (owner: Sam) — target: today EOD UTC. (B) Ibrahim to validate KV-cache toggle + small-model fallback test (owner: Ibrahim) — target: tomorrow noon UTC. (C) Kelsey to share ingest playbook and chunking guidance with LuminaCare (owner: Kelsey) — target: tomorrow EOD. (D) Alyssa to send renewal risk note to AE and include incident summary (owner: Alyssa) — target: tomorrow.
Sam (SRE): I’m on (A). Will post deploy link + canary results here when started.
Ibrahim (Support Eng): starting validation of cache toggle now. I’ll paste a quick repro and logs.
Ibrahim (Support Eng): repro log snippet:
```
[2026-02-18T11:38:41Z] request id=abc123 model=redwood-13b seq=320 tokens_in=540 tokens_out=12 status=503 reason=kv-cache-thrash pod=rr-02
[2026-02-18T11:39:02Z] pod rr-02 restart reason=OOMKilled
```
Nora (LuminaCare): thanks — appreciate the quick response. We can hold off large runs until you confirm mitigations. Will coordinate with our infra team.
Kelsey (Onboarding): will attach a short checklist for batching/chunking and a sample script to gate concurrency.
observability-bot: Deploy job created by Sam: deploy/rollout/4632, canary started.
Sam (SRE): canary looks good so far (10m). No additional 503s in canary traffic. Rolling remaining replicas now.
Alyssa (CSM): great — please flag if any regressions. I’ll follow up in tomorrow’s account health email and include the actions + timelines.
Nora (LuminaCare): thanks everyone. If we see another incident I’ll escalate to our CTO but hoping this settles. :thumbsup:
Sam (SRE): rolled. post-rollout checks green.
Ibrahim (Support Eng): validated KV toggle in staging, reduced peak mem by ~35% on long-sequence tests. Will request runtime change in next deploy cycle.
Alyssa (CSM): closing thread for now. Will reopen if anything else crops up. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
